shell_id.description: Stable id from process.list_shells / process.get_default_shell. If omitted in shell mode, the host default shell is used.

env_remove.description: Variable names to strip from the inherited environment before `env` overrides apply (an explicit `env` entry for the same key still wins). No effect with `env_mode: "replace"`, which already starts empty.

sandbox_profile.description: Per-command sandbox profile override. The override is scoped to this command and preserves the surrounding workspace roots and capability ceilings. workspace_paths keeps Harn path enforcement while omitting recursive OS process confinement for trusted toolchain commands.

background_after_ms.description: Spawn the command in the background and wait up to this many milliseconds for its terminal result. Progress does not shorten this window; if the deadline wins, return a running snapshot seeded from the latest progress.

progress_interval_ms.description: When the command runs in the background, publish the first progress feedback after this delay. It is the base of an exponential backoff schedule: the interval doubles after each snapshot up to progress_max_interval_ms.

progress_max_interval_ms.description: Ceiling for the progress backoff schedule seeded by progress_interval_ms. Progress starts frequent and thins out for a long-running command, capped here. Defaults to 30000ms; clamped to be at least progress_interval_ms.

progress_max_inline_bytes.description: Maximum stdout/stderr bytes included inline in each background progress item.

transport.description: Capture stdout/stderr through host pipes (default) or private temporary files. File transport is foreground-only and returns when the direct child exits even if descendants retain stdio handles.

capture_stderr.description: Deprecated compatibility flag; false maps to capture.merge_stderr.

sandbox.description: Internal hostlib sandbox scope for trusted stdlib callers. Agent-visible tool schemas should not expose this field.

snapshot_binding.description: Opaque caller-provided verification snapshot binding, typically the output of hostlib_code_index_file_hash_snapshot captured immediately before launching a background command.
